_comment: Project-owned. detect-toolchain.sh never reads or writes this file; common.sh merges it over toolchain.json, manual wins. The detector has no C/C++ stack, so the per-file gates are declared here by hand.
_comment_secrets: gitleaks 8.30.1: `protect` still works but is deprecated upstream. Pinned to the modern `gitleaks git --staged` here so a future gitleaks that drops `protect` cannot turn the pre-commit gate into a confusing hard block. Both verified 2026-08-31 to exit 1 on a staged fake token.
